definitions.explanation: The state of something that has not completely dried, especially laundry. Often associated with an unpleasant musty smell.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}が{生乾|なまがわ}きだ。
{生乾|なまがわ}きの{服|ふく}は{臭|にお}いがする。
{梅雨|つゆ}の{時期|じき}は{洗濯物|せんたくもの}が{生乾|なまがわ}きになりやすいので、{部屋干|へやぼ}しには{除湿機|じょしつき}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: During the rainy season, laundry tends to stay damp, so I use a dehumidifier when drying clothes indoors.

notes:
{生乾|なまがわ}き is composed of {生|なま} (raw, half-) + {乾|かわ}き (drying).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生乾|なまがわ}きの{臭|にお}い: musty smell from damp clothes
- {生乾|なまがわ}きになる: to become half-dried
- {生乾|なまがわ}きを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent damp laundry

USAGE: A very common term in daily life, especially during {梅雨|つゆ} (rainy season) when drying laundry outdoors is difficult. The musty smell associated with {生乾|なまがわ}き is a frequent topic of conversation and advertising for laundry products.
